question: The most common tool for the Iron Age was the ______, which was used for felling trees, chopping wood, and as a weapon.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Axe**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The axe was the most versatile tool during the **Iron Age**.
 
• It was used for felling trees, chopping wood, and even as a weapon in battles.
 
• The introduction of iron made the axe more durable and efficient than earlier tools made of **bronze **or stone</strong
